message.content:
In this repository (likely a memo/notes app), I need to find where each memo carries DERIVED metadata that is computed from its content (not set by the user), used for lists/previews. This might include things like tags, display paragraph/snippet, has-code, has-link, has-task-list, word count, etc.

Find:
1. The exact function/file/location where this metadata is computed from the memo content.
2. Which operations (create/update/etc.) trigger recomputation.
3. What properties the computation extracts.

Search broadly — look for terms like "property", "properties", "getMemoProperty", "GetMemoProperty", "rebuildMemoProperty", "hasLink", "hasTaskList", "hasCode", "payload", "content" parsing, markdown AST traversal. Report exact file paths and line numbers and code snippets. Be very thorough.

I have a complete picture. Here are my findings.

## Summary

This is the **memos** app (usememos). Each memo carries derived metadata in a protobuf `MemoPayload` that is computed from the memo's markdown content by walking a goldmark AST. There are two derived pieces: **`Property`** (boolean flags + title) and **`Tags`**, both stored in the payload; plus a **`Snippet`** that is computed on-the-fly at read time (not stored).

## 1. Where the metadata is computed

**Primary extraction: `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go`**

- `ExtractAll(content []byte) (*ExtractedData, error)` — lines **356-422**. The single-pass extractor used in production. Parses content into a goldmark AST (`s.parse`, line 116) and does one `gast.Walk` collecting tags, mentions, and properties.
- `ExtractProperties(content []byte)` — lines **193-241**. A properties-only variant (same logic, not used by the rebuild path).
- `GenerateSnippet(content []byte, maxLength int)` — lines **264-346**. Produces the plain-text preview snippet.
- Helper `extractHeadingText` (lines 173-179) / `extractTextFromNode` (182-190) pull the H1 title text.

`ExtractedData` struct (lines 21-25) holds `Tags []string`, `Mentions []string`, `Property *storepb.MemoPayload_Property`.

**Assembly into the memo payload: `/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`**

- `RebuildMemoPayload(_ ctx, memo *store.Memo, markdownService)` — lines **74-88**. Calls `markdownService.ExtractAll([]byte(memo.Content))` and assigns:
  - `memo.Payload.Tags = data.Tags` (line 85)
  - `memo.Payload.Property = data.Property` (line 86)

The AST-walk core that actually extracts the properties is lines **371-411** of markdown.go:
```go
case gast.KindLink:
    data.Property.HasLink = true
case gast.KindCodeBlock, gast.KindFencedCodeBlock, gast.KindCodeSpan:
    data.Property.HasCode = true
case east.KindTaskCheckBox:
    data.Property.HasTaskList = true
    if checkBox, ok := n.(*east.TaskCheckBox); ok {
        if !checkBox.IsChecked {
            data.Property.HasIncompleteTasks = true
        }
    }
```
Title is set from the first block-level H1 heading (lines 384-389). Tags come from `asMemoTagNode` (line 376), mentions from `MentionNode` (line 379).

## 2. What operations trigger recomputation

`RebuildMemoPayload` is called from `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`:
- **Create memo** — line **108** (in `CreateMemo`), on the new memo before storing.
- **Update memo** — line **447** (in `UpdateMemo`), but only when the update mask includes `"content"` (guard at line 436; `memo.Content` set at line 446, payload written to `update.Payload` at line 451).

Bulk/backfill recomputation:
- `/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go` `Runner.RunOnce` (lines 27-72) iterates all memos in batches of 100, calling `RebuildMemoPayload` + `Store.UpdateMemo`. Note: this runner is defined but I did not find it wired into `server.go` startup — it appears to be a standalone/migration utility.

Snippet (read-time, not stored): computed in the store→API converter, `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go` line **76-80** via `getMemoContentSnippet`, which lives at `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go` lines **83-90** and calls `GenerateSnippet(content, 64)`. Also computed for related memos at converter lines 224-252.

## 3. Properties extracted

Defined in `/bench/repo/proto/store/memo.proto` (`MemoPayload`, lines 7-29):
- `MemoPayload.Property` (message `Property`, lines 15-22, "The calculated properties from the memo content"):
  - `has_link` (bool)
  - `has_task_list` (bool)
  - `has_code` (bool)
  - `has_incomplete_tasks` (bool)
  - `title` (string — from first H1 heading)
- `MemoPayload.tags` (repeated string, line 12) — derived `#tags`
- `MemoPayload.location` (line 10) — NOT derived from content; set from the request (`memo_service.go` line 112).

The store `Property` is converted to the API `Memo_Property` in `memo_service_converter.go` `convertMemoPropertyFromStore` (lines **315-326**), exposing exactly those five fields; `Tags` copied at line 48, and the on-the-fly `Snippet` set at line 80.

Consumers of these derived flags include `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/user_service_stats.go` (lines 141-151, 257-267) which aggregate `HasLink`/`HasCode`/`HasTaskList`/`HasIncompleteTasks` counts.

Note: word count is NOT among the extracted properties in this codebase — the derived set is has-link, has-code, has-task-list, has-incomplete-tasks, title, tags (and the read-time snippet).
